doc: Kuwahara oil-paint filter, classic 4 overlapping quadrants of (radius+1)^2 px around the pixel; each pixel takes the mean colour of the quadrant with the lowest luma variance (variance of the integer 8-bit luma) (flat painterly regions, edges preserved). Radii above 6 px stride-subsample the window (stride = ceil(radius/6), at most 13x13 taps). Means are taken over premultiplied rgba (alpha weighted straight colour, alpha = mean alpha of the chosen quadrant). The quadrant is chosen with exact integer arithmetic (integer straight 8-bit luma, N*S2 - S1^2, ties -> lowest index), identical on every GPU.
